verdictRationale: Core architecture, SSR test engine, client autosave, monotonic sequence sync, rights isolation, D1 capacity optimization, SEO structure, copy honesty, and security hardening are verified with 294 passing tests and 0 sitemap mismatches. However, overall verdict is capped at PARTIAL because 214 previous-year practice papers have unknown copyright provenance (appropriately isolated and noindexed) and 1,204 auto-generated explanations are pending human review in the review queue.

scorecard.reason: Full mock attempt lifecycle verified: 15s delta autosave with monotonic sequence sync, timer countdown with 15s grace, palette jump, section navigation, submit, and retry.
Pure data-driven scoring (+5/-1 default, sectional schemes), blueprint tie-breakers (score desc -> time asc -> accuracy desc), first-attempt rule enforced.
PBKDF2/scrypt hashed passwords, SHA-256 session tokens, guest token claim flow, Google OAuth contract, private-by-default profiles.
Coverage across questions, mocks, practice papers, review queue, rights confirmations, and audit logs. Cloudflare Access JWT auth required in production.
347 mocks, 12,066 questions, 214 practice papers; 214 papers marked rights unknown and 1,204 explanations marked unreviewed AI drafts.
89 indexable URLs in sitemap with 0 mismatches; clean canonicals, single h1, valid schema types (BreadcrumbList, Article, WebSite), no Quiz/Course spam.
WCAG AA contrast verified across light and dark themes; no-flash inline script; zero hardcoded color leaks; 79 design token unit tests passing.
10-character Base62 public IDs with rejection sampling; database IDs never exposed; rights gate revokes PYQ links if unconfirmed; OG card generation.
Strict PNG/JPEG/WebP magic-byte validation; SVGs strictly rejected; sandbox and nosniff CSP headers; KaTeX LaTeX rendering.
Answer keys omitted from public payloads; timer grace enforced; IDOR guards on attempts; KV rate limits on 9 public endpoints; 0 vulnerabilities in npm audit.
Simulated mobile Lighthouse audits completed across 9 routes in light/dark themes; D1 capacity model verified (autosave <= 3 rows read; result <= 40 rows read).
Automated axe-core audits across public, dashboard, attempt (with palette), result, solutions, and admin views with 0 critical/serious violations.
40 test files, 294 unit/integration tests passing (100% pass rate in 9.35s); GitHub Actions CI workflow for test, build, lint, axe, and SEO consistency.
Wrangler environments separated (preview vs production D1); daily offsite backup workflow configured; launch runbook documented.
Explicit NTA disclaimer in footer and headers; takedown procedure published; AdSense restricted to substantial public content pages only; no spam claims.
Google OAuth contract, Cloudflare Access JWT validation, Cloudflare Web Analytics token integration, Google Site Verification integration.
